title: Vending Machines, Car Washes, Storage Units: The Real Numbers
description:
Vending machines, car washes and storage units are sold as passive income. Here are the real numbers on all three: what they cost, what they earn, where the money goes and where people lose it.

Get The Ryan Rover Money Playbook: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:49 How we got the numbers
2:11 Part 1: Vending machines
7:59 Part 2: Car washes
14:17 Part 3: Storage units
19:38 Side by side
20:36 Other passive income favorites, quickly
21:46 What fits your budget
23:22 Three investors, three outcomes
24:30 Five mistakes that sink these investments
25:24 Angle 1: The numbers
27:14 Angle 2: The psychology
29:06 How to estimate the numbers from the outside
30:13 Angle 3: The playbook
31:34 Questions people ask
33:18 Recap
34:14 What to do next

Sources:
- All vending, car wash and storage figures: simplified illustrations built for teaching, not industry averages or quotes
- U.S. Small Business Administration, 7(a) and 504 loan programs (financing for business and real estate)
- Cap rate valuation: standard commercial real estate method (net operating income divided by capitalization rate)
- Market comparison: stated illustrative 7% average yearly return

Photos: Wikimedia Commons contributors. Full credits and licenses: https://github.com/ryan-rover-money-channel/ryan-rover-money/blob/main/agendamento/creditos/video18.md

This video is for education only and is not financial advice. Numbers are illustrations, not promises.
